mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month, indicating reduced consumer spending power, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% YoY, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and high inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month, signaling labor market weakness, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% YoY, indicating strong economic expansion, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% YoY.
